title: The library desk, from the IT side
subtitle: One clone, one command, one stack

slides.heading: The stack
slides.narration: This is the IT view of the library desk. One minute covers the stack, the install, the run, and where the data lives.

slides.heading: Four parts, one pack
slides.narration: The stack has four parts: a FastAPI backend over SQLite, a LangGraph agent harness, a React dashboard, and the library pack that carries every domain word.

slides.heading: Install once
slides.narration: Install runs twice and seeds once. uv sync fills the Python environment, npm install fills the dashboard set, and npm run seed builds the loan desk queue from the pack.

slides.heading: Run with one command
slides.narration: One command starts the whole desk. npm run dev brings up the backend, the agent, the copilot, and the dashboard. The desk lives on port 5173, the API on 8000.

slides.heading: Switching domains
slides.narration: The engine carries no domain words. CRM_DOMAIN names the active pack, and the same binary runs the library desk or any other domain with no code change.

slides.heading: The checks that guard it
bullets: One npm run check for the suite
The devcontainer and floci run the same
slides.narration: The checks run everywhere. One npm run check drives the whole suite, the validator examines the pack, and the devcontainer and the floci emulator run the same commands.
